title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 18
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 18: Yahweh's call not to follow the customs of Egypt and Canaan, the forbidden relationships and the warning about the land.

questions.text: Whose practices were the Israelites not to follow?
questions.explanation: They were not to do as they do in the land of Egypt, where they lived, or in the land of Canaan, where Yahweh was bringing them.

answers.text: Those of the lands of Egypt and Canaan

questions.text: What does Yahweh say about a man who does his statutes and ordinances?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says to keep his statutes and ordinances, 'which if a man does, he shall live in them.'

answers.text: He shall rule over the nations

questions.text: What general rule opens the list of forbidden relationships?
questions.explanation: None of them shall approach any close relatives, to uncover their nakedness.

answers.text: No one shall marry a foreigner
No one shall marry before age twenty
No one shall marry a priest's daughter
No one shall approach any close relative

questions.text: How is a father's sister described in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Of the father's sister Yahweh says, 'She is your father's near kinswoman.'

questions.text: How is the wife of your father's brother described?
questions.explanation: You shall not approach his wife. 'She is your aunt.'

questions.text: Why may a man not take his wife's sister as a wife too while his wife is alive?
questions.explanation: He shall not take a wife in addition to her sister, to be a rival, while her sister is still alive.

answers.text: Sisters may not live in one tent

questions.text: To whom were the Israelites not to give any of their children as a sacrifice?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, 'You shall not give any of your children as a sacrifice to Molech.'

questions.text: What did the land do to its inhabitants because it was defiled?
questions.explanation: The land was defiled, Yahweh punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out her inhabitants.

questions.text: Who must keep these statutes and not do these abominations?
questions.explanation: Neither the native-born nor the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them may do any of these abominations.

answers.text: Only the priests and the Levites
Only the men of the twelve tribes
Only those living inside the cities
Both the native-born and the stranger among them

questions.text: What happens to those who do any of these abominations?
questions.explanation: The souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.

answers.text: They pay double to the priest
They must leave Israel for a year
They are cut off from among their people
